Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: After acceptance the receipt shows identifiers only and the breadcrumb still names the old release.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Receipt summarises the accepted change in curator terms: document, fields or rows changed, files affected, findings no longer reported.
2. Breadcrumb and page context point to the new head; "Open new release" lands on the corrected file.
3. "Matches preview" verification stays, inside Technical details.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (receiptCard)
